851-1283-1651-3129-8276.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Hive by paying {5} and tapping it, creating four 1/1 Wasp artifact creature tokens due to Primal Vigor and Adrix and Nev.
Activate Clock of Omens twice by tapping the Wasps, untapping Chromatic Orrery and The Hive.
Repeat.
851-1283-1651-3129-8276.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

2226-3977-6751.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-3977-6751.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Starfield Vocalist.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Horned Kavu by paying its mana cost.
When Horned Kavu enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

1116-4210-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1116-4210-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple, Sek'Kuar and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar ability, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token with haste.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4289-5457--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4289-5457--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Selvala triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3129-4365-4772-6664-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

573-1315-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Gruul Turf.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Gruul Turf from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Gruul Turf enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Repeat.

2457-4289-7730-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1651-2561-4559-7824.description:
Activate The Underworld Cookbook's first ability by tapping it and discarding Metalwork Colossus, creating two Food tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Foods, untapping The Underworld Cookbook.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Foods, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1308-5660-6462-7368-7824.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4742-7795.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4742-7795.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Drider, triggering Breath of Fury and Drider.
Resolve the Drider trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2488-3213-7167.description:
Cast Apex Altisaur by paying {7}{G}{G}.
When Apex Altisaur enters, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Boromir by sacrificing it, giving creatures you control indestructible until end of turn.
Resolve the Apex Altisaur trigger, causing it to fight a creature you don't control.
If the opposing creature dealt damage to Apex Altisaur, Apex Altisaur's second ability and Wrathful Raptors trigger.
Resolve the Wrathful Raptors trigger, dealing damage to any opponent.
Resolve the Apex Altisaur trigger, causing it to fight a creature you don't control.
Repeat from step 4 until your opponents control no creatures. If they happen to control an indestructible creature with power above 0, this loop can be done infinitely.
2488-3213-7167.notes: You can restart the loop if opponents control creatures by dealing damage to Apex Altisaur. It may not have indestructible by this point however unless you use another source to provide it.

2034-3480-5477-5660-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the tapped Plant, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Grub, Storied Matriarch // Grub, Notorious Auntie

955-2105-7196.description:
Declare Grub and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks. Grub and Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Grub trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on Combat Celebrant and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of it.
Combat Celebrant dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase, using the Combat Celebrant token instead.

891-3055-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

413-1687-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
413-1687-5972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

1482-4195-4574-6918.description:
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Jeweled Lotus from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

3764-4871-6798.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Pincher.
When the Pincher dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

413-4215-6730.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sin.
When Sin dies, it and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Sin trigger, moving any counters from it onto another creature you control, and then shuffling Sin into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Sin and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Sin enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station,
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
413-4215-6730.notes: In order to get infinite +1/+1 counters, remove as many counters as possible when Sin enters, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin as it enters. Those counters can then be moved to another creature when Sin dies.

requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

1636-3197-6702--119.description:
Tap Kilo by any method.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1636-3197-6702--119.notes: This combo also gives you infinite products from whatever method you use to tap Kilo.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

974-1235-2187.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating a token copy of the Smaug token and Possessed Skaab with haste.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Smaug token that died and the Possessed Skaab token trigger.
Resolve the Smaug trigger, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Twinflame from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

647-1563-2457-4772.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-4871-6291.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

147-5362.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Quantum Misalignment
147-5362.description:
Cast Quantum Misalignment by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Quantum Misalignment, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Quantum Misalignment, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

1558-2963-3567-4840.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle and Trove of Temptation trigger.
Resolve the Teleportation Circle trigger, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Resolve the Trove of Temptation trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing the Treasure and Myrs, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

752-914-2928-3094.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least ten artifacts and/or enchantments.
752-914-2928-3094.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least ten Treasure tokens.
Activate seven Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{R}{W}.
Cast Leave by paying {1}{W}.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying Leave.
Resolve the copy of Leave, returning Dockside Extortionist and Lithoform Engine from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least ten Treasure tokens.
Activate nine Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {8}{R}.
Cast Lithoform Engine by paying {4}.
Repeat from step 5.

339-2713-4896.notablePrerequisites: Jegantha does not have summoning sickness.
339-2713-4896.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate High Alert by paying {W}{U}, untapping Jegantha.
Repeat.

2292-2452-2577.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional Zombie.
2292-2452-2577.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat.

739-937-2935.description:
During your upkeep, activate Ethereal Champion by paying 1 life, preventing the next one damage that will be dealt to Ethereal Champion this turn.
Repeat step 1 until you have zero life.
Activate Magus of the Mirror by tapping and sacrificing it, exchanging your life total with an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
